name: My Elven Commander Can't Be This Lewd!
source:
You thought you were going to stay home and chill all of valentines day. But that would all change as from out of nowhere, a message would appear in your mailbox. 

A direct order from Eliena, the commander. Asking you out on a secret mission. Maybe this holiday won't be so boring after all.

[From [url=https://monsterboxgames.itch.io/my-elf-command-cant-be-that-lewd]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你原以为，整个情人节都会待在家里放松。可毫无预兆地，一封消息出现在邮箱里，改变了一切。

那是指挥官艾莉娜下达的直接命令，邀请你参加一项秘密任务。看来，这个节日或许不会那么无聊了。

[摘自[url=https://monsterboxgames.itch.io/my-elf-command-cant-be-that-lewd]Itch.io[/url]]
